name: @chirp/app-protocol
description: App-side chat protocol layer for chirp companion apps (web companion + desktop). Lives under apps/ by design: sdks/ is the game-facing integration surface, apps carry their own protocol code (same layout rule as apps/android .../protocol/ and apps/ios Sources/ChirpProtocol/). Kept in lockstep with the game SDK's test vectors; no React/DOM dependencies.
